source.scope: 2026 season (gol.gg S16), split-Summer only; season_games from data/golgg_players_2026.json (split-ALL)

notes: CBLOL: gol.gg split-Summer = CBLOL 2026 Split 2, CBLOL 2026 Split 2 Playoffs
LCK: gol.gg split-Summer = LCK 2026 Rounds 3-4, LCK 2026 Season Play-In, LCK 2026 Season Playoffs
LCS: gol.gg split-Summer = LCS 2026 Summer, LCS 2026 Summer Playoffs
LEC: gol.gg split-Summer = LEC 2026 Summer Playoffs, LEC 2026 Summer Season
LPL: gol.gg split-Summer = LPL 2026 Grand Finals, LPL 2026 Regional Finals, LPL 2026 Split 3

International/other events also inside split-Summer on gol.gg (included in the players' split stats if they played them): 2026 World Star Challengers Invitational, Demacia Cup Global Invitational 2026, Esports World Cup 2026, KeSPA Cup 2026, Worlds 2026 Play-In

gol.gg maps every league onto four S16 split labels regardless of the league's own naming: Pre-Season (Kespa Cup 2025), Winter (LCK Cup / LPL Split 1 / LCP Split 1 / CBLOL Cup / LCS Lock-In / LEC Versus / First Stand), Spring (LCK Rounds 1-2 + Road to MSI / LPL Split 2 / LCP Split 2 / CBLOL Split 1 / LCS+LEC Spring / MSI) and Summer (LCK Rounds 3-4 + Season Play-In/Playoffs / LPL Split 3 + Grand + Regional Finals / LCP Split 3 / CBLOL Split 2 / LCS+LEC Summer / EWC / Worlds Play-In). The four splits sum to the split-ALL season total.
Stats are per player (own games only); a split value is the player's own games in that split, so subs/mid-season joiners show fewer games than team-mates and split_share = games / season_games.
